core/1/1.1/1.title: Rational Numbers
outcomes: Understand rational numbers and the relationships among them, and use their properties to solve mathematical and real-life problems.
Understand and use the properties of powers with positive integer exponents to solve mathematical and real-life problems.
content: - Applying knowledge of integers, rational numbers, and powers to solve problems

core/1/1.1/3.title: Ratios
outcomes: Understand and apply ratios, proportions, and percentages to solve mathematical and real-life problems.
content: - Applying knowledge of ratios, proportions, and percentages to solve problems

core/2/1.1/1.title: Rational Numbers
outcomes: Understand and use the properties of powers with integer exponents to solve mathematical and real-life problems.
content: - Applying knowledge of powers to solve problems

core/2/1.1/2.title: Real Numbers
outcomes: Understand real numbers and the relationships among them, and use their properties to solve mathematical and real-life problems.
content: - Square roots and cube roots of rational numbers

core/4/1.1/1.title: Sets
outcomes: Understand and use knowledge of sets and elementary logic to communicate and convey mathematical meaning.
content: - Introduction to sets and basic set notation
- Union, intersection, and complement of sets
- Propositions and logical connectives (negation, and, or, if ... then ..., if and only if)

core/5/1.1/1.title: Powers
outcomes: Understand the meaning of addition, multiplication, equality, and inequality, and use their properties for real numbers written in radical form and real numbers written as powers with rational exponents.
content: - The nth root of a real number, where n is a natural number greater than 1

core/2/1.2/1.title: Polynomials
outcomes: Understand the principles of operations on polynomials and use polynomials to solve mathematical problems.
content: - Addition, subtraction, and multiplication of polynomials
- Division of a polynomial by a monomial when the quotient is a polynomial

core/2/1.2/2.title: Factoring Polynomials
outcomes: Understand and use the factoring of quadratic polynomials to solve mathematical problems.

core/3/1.2/1.title: Factoring Polynomials
outcomes: Understand and use the factoring of polynomials of degree greater than two to solve mathematical problems.
content: - Factoring polynomials of degree greater than two

core/3/1.2/2.title: Quadratic Functions
outcomes: Understand and use knowledge of quadratic functions to solve mathematical problems.
content: - Applying knowledge of quadratic functions to solve problems

core/5/1.2/1.title: Functions
outcomes: Use functions and their graphs to describe given situations.
content: - Functions and their graphs (linear functions, quadratic functions, step functions, and exponential functions)

core/5/1.2/2.title: Sequences and Series
outcomes: Understand and apply knowledge of sequences and series.

core/1/1.3/1.title: Linear Equations in One Variable
outcomes: Understand and use the properties of equality and the properties of numbers to analyze and solve problems using linear equations in one variable.
content: - Solving linear equations in one variable
- Applying knowledge of how to solve linear equations in one variable in real life

core/1/1.3/2.title: Linear Equations in Two Variables
outcomes: Understand and use knowledge of graphs to solve mathematical and real-life problems.
Understand and use knowledge of linear relationships to solve mathematical and real-life problems.
content: - Applying knowledge of linear equations in two variables and graphs of linear relationships in real life

core/3/1.3/1.title: Linear Inequalities in One Variable
outcomes: Understand and use the properties of inequality to analyze and solve problems using linear inequalities in one variable.
content: - Solving linear inequalities in one variable
- Applying knowledge of how to solve linear inequalities in one variable to solve problems

core/3/1.3/2.title: Quadratic Equations in One Variable
outcomes: Apply quadratic equations in one variable to solve mathematical problems.
content: - Solving quadratic equations in one variable
- Applying knowledge of how to solve quadratic equations in one variable to solve problems

core/3/1.3/3.title: Systems of Equations
outcomes: Apply systems of linear equations in two variables to solve mathematical problems.
content: - Systems of linear equations in two variables
- Solving systems of linear equations in two variables
- Applying knowledge of how to solve systems of linear equations in two variables to solve problems

core/5/1.3/1.title: Interest and the Value of Money
outcomes: Understand and use knowledge of interest and the value of money to solve problems.

core/2/2.1/1.title: Surface Area
outcomes: Apply knowledge of the surface area of prisms and cylinders to solve mathematical and real-life problems.
content: - Finding the surface area of prisms and cylinders
- Applying knowledge of the surface area of prisms and cylinders to solve problems

core/2/2.1/2.title: Volume
outcomes: Apply knowledge of the volume of prisms and cylinders to solve mathematical and real-life problems.
content: - Finding the volume of prisms and cylinders
- Applying knowledge of the volume of prisms and cylinders to solve problems

core/3/2.1/1.title: Surface Area
outcomes: Apply knowledge of the surface area of pyramids, cones, and spheres to solve mathematical and real-life problems.
content: - Finding the surface area of pyramids, cones, and spheres
- Applying knowledge of the surface area of pyramids, cones, and spheres to solve problems

core/3/2.1/2.title: Volume
outcomes: Apply knowledge of the volume of pyramids, cones, and spheres to solve mathematical and real-life problems.
content: - Finding the volume of pyramids, cones, and spheres
- Applying knowledge of the volume of pyramids, cones, and spheres to solve problems

core/1/2.2/1.title: Geometric Constructions
outcomes: Use geometric knowledge and tools such as a compass and straightedge, as well as The Geometer’s Sketchpad or other dynamic geometry software, to construct geometric figures and apply knowledge of these constructions to solve real-life problems.
content: - Constructing two-dimensional geometric figures using basic geometric constructions
- Applying knowledge of basic geometric constructions in real life

core/1/2.2/2.title: Dimensional Relationships of Geometric Figures
outcomes: Understand and use geometric knowledge to analyze the relationships between two-dimensional and three-dimensional geometric figures.
content: - Cross sections of three-dimensional geometric figures
- Front, side, and top views of three-dimensional geometric figures made up of cubes

core/2/2.2/1.title: Geometric Constructions
outcomes: Use geometric knowledge and tools such as a compass and straightedge, as well as The Geometer’s Sketchpad or other dynamic geometry software, to construct geometric figures and apply knowledge of these constructions to solve real-life problems.
content: - Applying knowledge of geometric constructions in real life

core/2/2.2/2.title: Parallel Lines
outcomes: Use knowledge of the properties of parallel lines and triangles to solve mathematical problems.
content: - Properties of parallel lines and triangles

core/2/2.2/3.title: Geometric Transformations
outcomes: Understand and use knowledge of geometric transformations to solve mathematical and real-life problems.
content: - Applying knowledge of geometric transformations to solve problems

core/2/2.2/4.title: Congruence
outcomes: Understand and use the properties of congruent triangles to solve mathematical and real-life problems.
content: - Applying knowledge of congruence to solve problems

core/2/2.2/5.title: The Pythagorean Theorem
outcomes: Understand and use the Pythagorean theorem and its converse to solve mathematical and real-life problems.
content: - The Pythagorean theorem and its converse
- Applying knowledge of the Pythagorean theorem and its converse in real life

core/3/2.2/1.title: Similarity
outcomes: Understand and use the properties of similar triangles to solve mathematical and real-life problems.
content: - Applying knowledge of similarity to solve problems

core/3/2.2/2.title: Trigonometric Ratios
outcomes: Understand and use knowledge of trigonometric ratios to solve mathematical and real-life problems.
content: - Using the values of trigonometric ratios for angles of 30°, 45°, and 60° to solve problems

core/3/2.2/3.title: Circles
outcomes: Understand and use circle theorems to solve mathematical problems.

core/1/3.1/1.title: Statistics
outcomes: Understand and use statistical knowledge to present and interpret data, and apply statistics in real life using appropriate technology.

core/2/3.1/1.title: Statistics
outcomes: Understand and use statistical knowledge to present data, analyze data from dot plots, stem-and-leaf plots, histograms, and measures of central tendency, and interpret the results. Apply statistics in real life using appropriate technology.

core/3/3.1/1.title: Statistics
outcomes: Understand and use statistical knowledge to present and analyze data from box plots and interpret the results. Apply statistics in real life using appropriate technology.

core/6/3.1/1.title: Statistics
outcomes: Understand and use statistical knowledge to present data and interpret statistical measures to inform decisions.
content: - Measures of central tendency (mode, median, arithmetic mean)
- Measures of dispersion (range, standard deviation, variance)

core/3/3.2/1.title: Probability
outcomes: Understand random experiments and use their outcomes to find the probabilities of events.
content: - Applying knowledge of probability in real life

core/4/3.2/1.title: Basic Counting Principles
outcomes: Understand and use the addition and multiplication principles, permutations, and combinations to solve problems.
content: - Linear permutations when all objects are distinct
- Combinations when all objects are distinct

core/4/3.2/2.title: Probability
outcomes: Calculate probabilities and apply knowledge of probability.
